description: LightLens group is created by four teenagers who are interested in space science subject. We seek this challenge to explore more about space.
summary:
When Mateo, a remote sensing specialist, suddenly disappears, his best friend Ani is left searching for answers. With no explanation and barely anything to work with, Ani refuses to believe that his friend simply vanished without a reason.

What begins as a desperate search soon leads him down an unfamiliar path of forgotten documents, strange recordings, encrypted messages and secrets buried within an old Minecraft world. Joined by unlikely companions, Ani finds himself uncovering pieces of a story that Mateo never intended to share so easily.

But the deeper he investigates, the more questions arise. What was Mateo hiding? Why did he leave? And will the answers bring Ani any closer to finding his missing friend?

Sometimes, the greatest discoveries aren't found by looking for answers, but by daring to explore what lies beyond the familiar.
details:
FARPOINT is a science-based storytelling project presented in the form of an storybook. Inspired by NASA's exploration of the Moon and the scientific legacy of lunar equipment, our project combines real scientific knowledge with a fictional narrative centred on friendship, responsibility and self-discovery. Through the story of a YouTuber searching for his missing best friend, a remote sensing specialist, readers gradually discover the importance of lunar exploration, historical NASA equipment and the scientific knowledge gained from past missions.

Our project aims to make scientific information more engaging and accessible, particularly for younger audiences. By incorporating astronomy, remote sensing and space exploration into an entertaining storyline, we hope to encourage curiosity and interest in science. Beyond its educational purpose, FARPOINT also explores the importance of friendship, understanding and responsibility, reminding readers to respect others' decisions and recognise the efforts behind scientific discoveries.

To develop FARPOINT, our team combined collaborative writing and research with the help of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Google Gemini to assist with brainstorming, refining written content and organising information, alongside NASA's educational and scientific resources to support factual accuracy. What makes our project creative is its use of a fictional mystery to communicate scientific knowledge rather than presenting facts alone. Throughout development, we considered our target audience, scientific accuracy, narrative coherence and visual presentation to maintain a balance between education and entertainment.
